_comment: Direct Ollama Cloud on its OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions wire. Reasoning controls go only to Models the catalog marks as reasoning; the effort vocabulary is none|low|medium|high|max (vBot xhigh is spelled max) and off is the explicit 'none' effort even for on/off thinkers. Readable reasoning replays as text in the Model's own response field. Bodies above 16 MiB are rejected (verified 2026-09-11).

rules.note: The catalog names the Model's verified readable reasoning field; replay returns it there.
